neighbours.label: the position where the name of a council, assembly or other governing body comes next (members of| the Security Council, serve on| juries, members| of parliament)
fire: Delegates from twenty countries met at the United Nations General Assembly.

Leaders will meet on the sidelines of the G20 summit next month.
The resolution passed in the state legislature by a narrow margin.
Women were finally allowed to serve on juries in that state.
quiet: Delegates from twenty countries enjoyed a dinner by the lake.
She was the first woman to win a medal in the national games.
The proposal was sent to her brother for his opinion.
He spent two summers on the farm of his grandparents.
The five oldest members of the choir sang a song.

The cake was baked in the old kitchen by a narrow window.

notes: Top examples (Chinese, Arabic, English) sit just before or inside council/congress/parliament names; output promotes council, forum, board, assembly. Probe: 'members of the Security Council' 0.39, but 'members of the family' 0.19, so the context is weakly specific.
